channel.title: Gaia's Secret Agents — Nature Missions & Printable Adventures
channel.description: Screen-free family nature missions, printable activities and outdoor adventures that help families connect with nature and each other.

item.title: Screen-Free Activities for Kids: Meet Bramblewicks
item.description: Every great agent starts with curiosity. Meet Bramblewicks, Keeper of the Files, and discover a story-led nature adventure for your family. Explore the printable Gaia’s Secret Agents Starter Kit for screen-free activities, secret-agent play and time together. Tap to see what is inside.

media:content.media:description: A red fox wearing a peacock-blue coat sits in a magical archive beneath the words Every Great Agent Starts With Curiosity.

item.title: Low-Waste Family Picnic: A Simple Earth Protector Challenge
item.description: Pack a picnic and skip the wrappers. Use a reusable lunchbox, bring refillable bottles and take your rubbish home. A practical sustainability activity for kids and families to try on their next outdoor adventure. Save these picnic tips, then explore more family nature missions from Gaia’s Secret Agents.

media:content.media:description: A parent and child share a picnic beside a reusable lunchbox and water bottle, with three tips for reducing picnic waste.

item.title: Free Printable Secret Agent Name Wheels and a Family Nature Hunt
item.description: How do you turn a walk into a secret mission? Make an agent name with two printable wheels, then head outside for a 15-minute Nature Signal Hunt. Get the free nine-page mission with a parent or guardian email.

media:content.media:description: A brass compass rests on a turquoise illustrated map near shells. Text invites families to choose an agent name.

item.title: Printable Family Adventure: Open a Secret Agent Recruitment File
item.description: What could you leave on the kitchen table for a curious child to discover? The 33-page printable Starter Kit opens with a recruitment story and leads into a real-world assignment. It’s a digital download you print at home. Explore the Starter Kit.

media:content.media:description: A gold-edged envelope peeks from a navy field satchel under a starry sky. Text introduces a printable family recruitment file.

item.title: Earth Protector Promise for Kids: Start With a Free Nature Mission
item.description: How can a family turn caring about nature into a promise a child understands? Start by noticing the living world together, then choose a simple commitment to respect and protect it. Get the free nine-page Nature Signal mission with a parent or guardian email.

media:content.media:description: Sunlight reaches a seagrass meadow beneath a calm coastline. Text introduces the Earth Protector Promise.

item.title: Print-at-Home Adventure Kit for Kids: What Do You Receive?
item.description: Looking for a family adventure you can prepare at home? The Secret Agent Starter Kit is a digital PDF. Print the 33-page file, prepare the pieces and invite your child into a story that leads outdoors. See what’s in the kit.

media:content.media:description: A plum-coloured desk holds blank cream paper, scissors and navy ribbon. Text explains the print-at-home kit.

item.title: Printable Wildlife Wall Art: Six Habitats for a Family Reading Nook
item.description: Which animal prints work together in a reading nook? This collection pairs six habitats in one coordinated set, from a golden wren in forest foliage to a polar bear under the aurora. Downloadable JPGs let you choose what to print. Explore all six artworks.

media:content.media:description: Six original Nature Habitat Collection prints arranged in two rows: golden wren, elephant, polar bear, koala, dolphins and sea turtle.

item.title: Beach Maths for Kids: A One-Minute Wave Counting Game
item.description: How can you turn a beach visit into a counting game? From a safe, dry spot with a grown-up, tally the waves that reach shore in one minute. Repeat three times and compare the totals. Try the Wave Pattern Mission in the free ocean activities guide.

media:content.media:description: Three foamy wave fronts approach a golden shore viewed from above.

item.title: Ocean Adventure for Kids Aged 6–11: Join the Ocean Discoverer Waitlist
item.description: When can our family start Ocean Discoverer? A parent or guardian can join the free waitlist for the release alert, a founding-agent printable and occasional mission updates. Join the Ocean Discoverer waitlist.

media:content.media:description: A lantern glows on a jetty at dusk beside a small portrait of Kai, a green sea turtle.

item.title: Polar Bear Wall Art: Which Frame Fits the Printable Arctic Portrait?
item.description: What size frame fits the polar bear print? The Arctic portrait has a 2:3 ratio, so a 20 × 30 cm frame matches its proportions. It comes as one of six downloadable wildlife JPGs. See the Nature Habitat Collection.

media:content.media:description: The original polar bear print appears in a gold frame over an illustrated Arctic aurora.

item.title: Printable nature adventure kit: which craft supplies do families need?
item.description: What should I have ready for the Starter Kit? Along with an A4 colour printer, gather paper, heavier card, scissors, glue or strong double-sided tape, a split pin and a pencil. A grown-up prepares the file. See the Starter Kit supply list.

media:content.media:description: A teal craft cupboard holds blank paper, scissors, a pencil, tape and brass fasteners.

item.title: Ocean current experiment for kids: follow a drop of colour at home
item.description: How can we see water moving without visiting the coast? Put a drop of food colouring at one end of a shallow dish of water. Gently move a spoon at the other end and follow the colour. Try the model current activity in the free ocean guide.

media:content.media:description: Blue food colouring curls through a clear dish of water beside a silver spoon.

item.title: Free nature mission for kids: start with a 15-minute outdoor hunt
item.description: How much outdoor time does the Nature Signal Hunt need? The free mission includes a 15-minute hunt, code-name wheels and an Earth Protector Promise. Allow extra time for printing and the other pages. Get the nine-page mission with a parent or guardian email.

media:content.media:description: An open turquoise gate leads into a brightly flowering garden.

item.title: Printable experience gift for kids: a nature adventure to prepare at home
item.description: What can I give a curious child who loves a mystery? The Starter Kit is a 33-page printable nature adventure for ages 6–11. A grown-up prepares the secret file at home before the child opens it. Explore the digital Starter Kit.

media:content.media:description: A navy gift box with gold ribbon sits beside eucalyptus on purple fabric; gift inspiration.
